name: Alfred Yamazaki
source:
Alfred is a junior, and a cheerful Christian. He has grown up in a pious Christian family and has been influenced greatly by his parents. He is a very warmhearted and comforting person. He listens well to others, and his kind attitude makes him easy for people to talk to. His weak point is unbelieving and his special ability is confession.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/empusa/empusa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
